text:
maria: quick sync — I pushed a draft of the structured-logging v2 schema and a sampling + redaction playbook. link: https://docs.redwood.internal/observability/log-schema-v2 (WIP). Can folks skim?

sasha: looked at it. overall +1. a few things: we need a compact set of mandatory keys for metrics/alerts, and a larger optional section for model/tenant debugging.

kevin: +1 from infra side. please call out fields that are required for Grafana traces / Loki indexing. ES costs blew up last q because we stored freeform user_text everywhere.

maria: agreed. my proposal: mandatory: `timestamp`, `service`, `env`, `region`, `pod`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, `level`, `msg_type`, `latency_ms`, `token_count`, `cost_usd`. optional: `tenant_id`, `model_id`, `gpu_id`, `input_sample` (redacted), `output_sample` (redacted), `kv_cache_hits`.

liz: for `input_sample`/`output_sample` we must never log raw PII. suggest we store hashes + redacted snippet plus a PII flag. e.g. `{ "pii_masked": true, "snippet": "<REDACTED_EMAIL>", "sha256_input": "abc..." }`.

oliver: +1. also add `sample_rate` and `sample_policy` metadata so downstream indexers know why this record exists.

maria: good call. i'm adding `sample_rate` (float 0-1) and `sample_basis` (enum: "always", "error", "random", "tenant_override", "anomaly") into mandatory-ish.

kevin: sampling strategy: default global random 0.01 (1%). escalate to 100% if `level` >= error or latency > 10s or token_count > 50k. tenant-based overrides: we keep 100% for enterprise tenants with contract flags. also keep 100% for incidents flagged by incident-bot.

sasha: operational notes: Loki ingestion prefers many small fields. don't put large arrays or big text blobs into the top-level. Put them in `payload.redacted` and route those messages to S3/Cold storage with a pointer in the log to avoid ES/Loki explosion.

maria: example of the top-level shape I'm proposing:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-02-12T14:23:01Z",
  "service": "inference-gateway",
  "env": "prod",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "pod": "igw-5f7b9",
  "request_id": "req_3b9f...",
  "trace_id": "span_abc...",
  "level": "info",
  "msg_type": "generation.result",
  "latency_ms": 312,
  "token_count": 120,
  "cost_usd": 0.0042,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "sample_basis": "random",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_984",
  "model_id": "rw-text-4b-quant",
  "input_snippet": {
    "pii_masked": true,
    "snippet": "order #<REDACTED>",
    "sha256": "e3b0c..."
  },
  "payload_ptr": "s3://redwood-logs/2026/02/12/req_3b9f.json.gz"
}
```

kevin: looks good. on retention/cost: anything with `payload_ptr` only gets 7d in hot storage by default, then cold for 365d. full payloads > 5kB are auto-shunted. we should document the 5kB threshold.

liz: PII redaction: we will run both a regex step (emails, phone, SSNs) then a small NER model for names/addresses. if the redaction confidence is low, route to redaction-queue for SRE review. Also add `pii_score` (0-1) and `pii_transform` enum: "regex", "ner", "manual", "none".

oliver: alert tuning: Prometheus rules should only depend on the mandatory top-level fields. e.g. `high-latency` alert uses `latency_ms` aggregated by `service` and `region`. Don't require optional fields for SLOs.

sasha: exporting the schema to our producers: i want a small producer SDK for go/python/node that validates and attaches sampling metadata before shipping. that will help ensure we don't accidentally send raw user_text.

maria: plan for rollout: (1) publish spec + producer SDK (2 weeks), (2) enable passive validation in staging for 1 week (logs still accepted but flagged), (3) white-list tenants to 100% sampling + enable redaction queue, (4) flip enforcement in prod + start sampling.

kevin: what's the capacity impact? we need to pre-provision extra disk and ES shards for the week of passive validation. i'd budget +15% ingestion.

maria: noted. also we should add a Grafana dashboard tile that shows `ingest_bytes/1m`, `sample_rate_avg`, `pii_masked_rate` and `redaction_queue_depth`.

liz: tuning note — keep redaction_queue_depth alert with a 5m window and threshold 100 items to avoid manual backlog.

oliver: i can prototype the producer SDK patterns this week. leaving a small spec in the repo: https://git.redwood/infra/logging/proto-v2.

deploy-bot: staging validation job started for schema-v2 on cluster `logs-staging`. status: running.

maria: thanks — please reply with objections by EOD Wednesday. Otherwise i'll merge and start the SDK work.

sasha: no objections from me. one nit: rename `cost_usd` to `estimated_cost_usd` to be explicit about per-request approximation.

maria: good catch. i'll update. merging tomorrow unless someone chimes in. :thumbsup:
